g.text: Each methodology string is matched to the ICVCM table by code and version range: approved (CCP-Approved,
including conditional), not_approved ("Does not meet"), or not_assessed (not listed, under assessment, or
version outside an assessed range). Examples: ACM0002 and AMS-I.D do not meet; GS TPDDTEC v2.0-3.1, VM0050,
VM0048 and the GS metered methodology v1.0-1.2 are approved; legacy REDD+ methodologies VM0007, VM0009 and
